purpose: Audit the evidence supporting a vehicle's passive cabin thermal model, from returned climate rows through normalization, segmentation, ordered gates and accepted Newton-cooling fits.
primaryGoal: Understand whether an accepted direction-specific thermal time constant is supported, inspect exclusions and rejected candidates, and distinguish a worked scenario from a weather forecast.

dataSources.ownership: ClimateHandler.List -> signal.StateReader.Timeline -> historical signal-log timeline; not a latest-state snapshot query.
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with a selected vehicle; key ['climate','history',vehicleId]; forwards AbortSignal; safeArray selection; inherits query policy. Handler defaults to the last seven days, supports start/end, forward-folds climate fields and emits timestamp/created_at/id aliases.
dataSources.units: Frontend ClimateState documents temperatures as Celsius. Request adds camelCase aliases without removing snake_case keys; model reads insideTemp/outsideTemp/hvacPower/isAcOn. No wire or cache conversion is performed here.
dataSources.limits: No actual endpoint call, timeline reader implementation, database completeness, sample density or freshness was tested. Forward-filled rows must not be treated as independent experiments.

dataSources.ownership: Existing workspace vehicle selection, display-unit preferences and locale/precision infrastructure.
dataSources.behavior: Deselection clears page analysis samples; component props receive saved temperature/duration preferences and formatters. No second vehicle picker, mutation, settings write or local query store.
dataSources.limits: Selection persistence, query-provider configuration and actual saved preferences were not exercised.

dataSources.ownership: Existing pure domain derivation; not a backend forecast capability.
dataSources.behavior: Separates raw rows, normalized rows, candidates and accepted fits. Ordered exclusion/rejection accounting, HVAC-off continuity, newest-first capped directories, accepted-only median tau and direction-specific medians.
dataSources.limits: Selected source ranges and symbols inspected; regression and segmentation internals were not exhaustively reviewed or executed.

components.contract: PageLayout delegates to PageContainer; CardGrid items have stable id/size/content, preserve source order and use allocated container width. CabinThermalGrid consumes placement without owning panels or actions.
Typed StatMetric raw values, period, loading/available/retained/error and specialist display formatters. Unknown coverage remains unknown; no generic completeness claim.

Five embedded charts retain toolbar, exportable data/dataColumns, accessible label and fallback table. Prediction retains cabin/ambient series and chartKey cabin-thermal-prediction with hidden-series state. Fit-quality scatter uses a static Legend, not the prediction's toggle contract.

components.owner: Existing category-barrel owners; domain gates in CabinThermalSectionBody and CabinThermalQueryStatus
components.contract: Passive section gates keep section shells visible; a single evidence-ledger status owns retry. Shared FadeIn uses reduced-motion preference and suppresses delayed entrance when reduced.
Preserve every specialist section and explanation. Domain components remain appropriate owners; do not replace them with a generic empty dashboard.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Detail and AcceptedDirectory.EventMetric repeat a label/value pair. Existing Typography already owns the visual primitives; only two local implementations are established.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep local until an existing shared label/value presentation is demonstrated compatible; optionally consolidate a domain-only renderer without changing values, ordering or caps.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Evidence, coverage, segmentation and exclusion sections reuse VehicleOperationalBrief, but embedded briefs repeat source status, coverage and not-live metadata. This is consistent architecture, with a potential secondary-information density cost rather than a proven rendering defect.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Review hierarchy in the mounted page; use the existing embedded contract, retaining source provenance and every metric rather than creating another summary component or removing explanations.

responsive.sourceBehavior: Root and slot have w-full/min-w-0; CardGrid stacks full/half cards under 1024 container pixels, uses half-width cards above that, and preserves DOM order. Candidate and accepted directories reflow field grids but retain bounded vertical scroll. Methodology reflows 1/2/3 columns.

findings.detail: The eight-reason chart reserves 150px for 10px category text plus 18px left margin in a fixed 230px chart. At phone widths this consumes much of the plot; long translated reasons can exceed the reserved label space. Funnel uses the same axis strategy.
findings.fix: Exercise narrow allocated widths and long translations; adapt label wrapping/height through existing chart contracts and keep complete labels in the accessible table/tooltip. Do not omit gates or counts.

findings.detail: Thresholds start at two columns even on phones, and direction-card measurements stay three columns. Scientific slope, duration ranges and long labels have no local wrap strategy; possible crowding at 320px or 200% text.
findings.fix: Validate and allow one-column threshold cards and wrapping/stacking measurement groups when allocated width is insufficient, preserving all nine thresholds and both direction profiles.

responsive.runtime: UNVERIFIED at all required widths: 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1024, 1280, 1440, 1920, 2560; no screenshot or measured overflow evidence.

sourceStrengths: Localized section titles and chart ariaLabel; decorative status/methodology icons are aria-hidden.
Charts supply complete data/dataColumns to shared fallback table; table caption and scoped header semantics exist in ChartContainer.
Candidate and accepted directories use ordered lists and textual accepted/rejection labels, not color alone.
Retry uses shared Button/QueryError; loading status has polite live region; shared PageContainer provides a route-focus target.
FadeIn uses the existing reduced-motion hook.

findings.detail: A bounded overflow-y-auto ordered list has no explicit accessible scroll-region name or tabIndex, and its rows have no interactive descendants. Keyboard-only access to overflow depends on browser scroll-focus behavior; accepted directory has the same pattern.
findings.fix: Test keyboard traversal and scrolling in supported browsers; if not reachable, name/focus the existing scroll region with shared focus styling. Do not introduce unnecessary row tab stops or discard capped metadata.

findings.detail: Chart numeric dataColumns omit kind/format. Shared fallback table uses String(raw) when neither is present, unlike locale-aware visible metrics. Count columns in the bar charts have the same omission; scenario decimals can be read/exported without the locale's separator convention.
findings.fix: Supply existing column kind/format metadata for count and specialist temperature/duration display, keeping chart source values and export units unchanged.

accessibility.runtime: UNVERIFIED keyboard/focus order and restoration, screen reader output, effective contrast, forced colors, touch targets, reduced-motion rendering, RTL and 200% text.

states.loading: Evidence metrics use unavailable raw values, QueryStatus announces loading, and passive section bodies render Skeleton without removing section titles. Methodology remains visible.
states.noVehicle: Page analysis uses []; localized selection guidance in status and passive sections, not a fabricated zero measurement.
states.empty: Resolved zero returned rows are legitimate zero counts with no tau claim. Normalized-empty, candidate-empty and all-rejected states have distinct explanations.
states.error: Only fatalError gates the content. QueryError owns initial retry; passive sections retain their shells. PageLayout receives query for header freshness, not loading/error props that would replace all content.
states.retained: Refresh failure keeps climateState.data, summary and section contents; evidence-ledger warning provides retry. Paused loading delegates to VehicleSourcePause; retained briefs disclose retained evidence.
states.unknown: Unresolved availability is not inferred empty; unknown HVAC excludes samples from candidates; missing accepted tau remains null/dash.
states.partial: Returned-but-invalid rows and rejected windows are explicitly accounted for. There is one historical query, not independent network sources; no generic partial network state is invented.
states.stale: Header delegates freshness to PageContainer/DataFreshnessAuto. Local sourceState retains refresh-error/paused signals but does not propagate timestamp/age; embedded briefs say not-live rather than claiming current observations.
states.runtime: All state descriptions are source-observed branches, not rendered acceptance. Retry effects, offline transitions, scope-change cancellation and retained cache behavior were not exercised.

visualIssues.detail: Ambient reference uses the saturated shared amber series token; adjacent count charts use blue/green/red series. These are data colors, not local glow decoration, but the reference line and multiple equal-weight saturated charts warrant a calmer intensity review. Shared palette is fixed hex across themes.
visualIssues.fix: Use a subdued existing reference token for ambient where distinguishable, and ask the shared chart-token owner to review restrained default series semantics. Preserve saved explicit neon chart preferences, all data, series identity and contrast.

architectureIssues.detail: This dated historical analysis is not in RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and useClimateHistory accepts vehicle only, so the page always analyzes the endpoint's default seven-day window rather than the shared workspace range. Backend already accepts start/end. Existing captions explicitly describe seven days; changing scope must update these truthfully.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should add typed optional start/end to the existing history hook/query key and register /cabin-thermal, then page consumes shared range instants. Preserve the existing default window for unscoped callers, cancellation, server-side filtering and all analysis rules; no second range picker.

priority.rationale: Already uses canonical layouts, state gates and chart frames; no evidenced feature loss or page-local neon decoration. Prioritize workspace-range integration and narrow/keyboard validation before cosmetic refinements.
order: Restrained reference color and metadata hierarchy review

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing climate-history workspace range integration
requiredSharedChanges.props: Optional typed start/end ISO instants; include supplied bounds in existing domain query key; keep vehicleId enablement, AbortSignal and safeArray.
requiredSharedChanges.variants: Existing unscoped seven-day default and explicitly workspace-scoped history; no alternative endpoint or query store.
requiredSharedChanges.states: Initial/empty/fatal/retained/paused behavior unchanged; both bounds sent to the server.
usedBy: Existing useClimateHistory consumers must retain their current unscoped behavior
requiredSharedChanges.status: Integration requirement from MDC-032; not implemented or runtime validated.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Restrained chart reference/default palette review
requiredSharedChanges.props: Reuse chartTokens reference/series semantics; no new palette engine or per-page hex constants.
requiredSharedChanges.variants: Calm default reference/series rendering across light/dark; preserve explicit saved chart palette choices.
requiredSharedChanges.states: Ensure distinction and effective contrast in normal and forced-color chart/table views.
dependsOn: Actual composed-theme contrast and visual review
requiredSharedChanges.status: Conditional review, not proof of failed contrast and not authorization to reset palettes.

competingImplementations.detail: Old six-MetricCard evidence band still exists and is barrel-exported alongside the active typed CabinThermalEvidenceStats/VehicleOperationalBrief presentation. The mounted page imports only the modernization ledger, so this is a competing local implementation, not a demonstrated double render.
competingImplementations.fix: Do not re-adopt the old color-per-metric band. Before any retirement, integration owner must verify other consumers/tests; no deletion authorized by this audit.

preservation.scopeLineCountDefinition: Page plus all non-test .ts/.tsx files in cabin-thermal and cabin-thermal-modernization, including the inactive KPI band and barrels; not a mounted-only count.
actions: Workspace vehicle selection; existing page title/help and header freshness
Single source retry/refetch owner for fatal, refresh-error or paused states
Five shared chart toolbars and chart data export surfaces
Prediction cabin/ambient legend toggling and stable chartKey
Candidate and accepted-directory scrolling with newest-first ordering and omission disclosure
dataBehavior: Raw wire/cache remains SI; Celsius temperature values and original aliases survive. No local units conversion in hook or cache.

Domain derivation currently uses elapsed minutes, tauMin and slope/min internally; preserve this numerical algorithm and rounding. Multiply minutes by 60 before duration formatters/shared duration metrics, not a wire-shape migration.
Temperature deltas use converted delta minus converted zero so Fahrenheit offset is not applied to differences.
Timestamp/finite-temperature validation, deterministic first-row duplicate retention and explicit HVAC-on/off/unknown resolution must remain.
Default thresholds: continuity gap 45min; duration 25min; 4 samples; initial gap 3 Celsius; R2 0.8; crossing band 0.2 Celsius; slope epsilon 0.000001/min; tau range 1-1440min.
Returned rows = normalized + excluded; candidates = accepted + rejected; final-reason counts = rejected. Diagnostics never become accepted thermal evidence.
Missing tau is null/dash, not zero; real resolved count zero remains zero.

Prediction is an explicitly hypothetical cooling 45/22/25 Celsius or warming 5/22/19 Celsius worked scenario, conditional on accepted directional tau. These are documented assumptions, not fixture telemetry or invented weather.
Keep model equation, ordered gates, seven-day source explanation until genuinely scoped, forward-filled-data caveat and sun/wind/occupancy/sensor/HVAC limitations.
preservation.verification: Root SHA-256 read twice and unchanged before report writing; no source edits. No runtime no-feature-loss claim.

evidenceLimits.method: Bounded read-only source audit. Root read in full; cited domain presentation files read in full; shared/backend files read at cited ranges or filtered symbols. No Git, nested agents, production actions, source edits or application startup.
evidenceLimits.mount: Source route registration only: web\src\App.tsx:89 and 862 lazy-loads the page behind SafeRoute. Actual authenticated mount was not exercised.
evidenceLimits.runtime: NOT RUN: browser, endpoint requests, screenshots, interactions, visual/theme/viewport acceptance, keyboard, screen reader, contrast, performance or export verification.
evidenceLimits.validation: NOT RUN: TypeScript, full lint/build or regression tests, per Phase 0 scoped prohibition. Skill audit.sh was inspected but not run because it unconditionally runs package TypeScript. Targeted read-only regex counts were used instead.
evidenceLimits.sourceCheckScope: Root page and non-test .ts/.tsx in the two cabin-thermal component directories. Regex results do not establish absence of inherited glow/saturation/pure-white styling: shared tokens and inactive MetricCard styling remain outside those literal counts.

commandEvidence.command: PowerShell: concatenate root and non-test files from cabin-thermal/cabin-thermal-modernization; count [regex]::Matches for the four patterns printed above; sum Get-Content line counts
commandEvidence.output: Raw scoped count lines retained in sourceCheckOutput; no TypeScript or runtime acceptance inferred.
LayoutCard openings = 13; EmbeddedChart openings = 5; Domain section openings = 14

unknowns: Backend signal.StateReader.Timeline implementation and deployed data completeness are not independently verified.
Active source may evolve under other owners; citations describe this audit snapshot only.
Domain tests/preservation test files were enumerated but not read or run; old acceptance is not borrowed.
Page does not have a locally evidenced glow/pure-white violation; shared chart palette intensity is a review finding, not measured contrast failure.
Full catalog coverage, external consumers of the inactive KPI band, preference persistence and translations were not audited.
